name: Email8
tagline: Email on Sentin8 — an SMTP/LMTP transfer engine, a mail & collaboration data core with JMAP, IMAP/POP3/Sieve/CalDAV access, and a TLS gate for the well-known ports.
pillarsLead: Email8 inherits the Sentin8 security model and adds mail's own guarantees — authenticated access on every protocol, DKIM-signed outbound, and TLS-only listeners.

pillars.title: One data core
pillars.summary: Store owns mailboxes, messages, folders, contacts, and calendars — MTA, Access, and Webmail all compose against it through authenticated APIs, never raw tables.

pillars.title: Signed outbound
pillars.summary: The MTA DKIM-signs every outbound message and generates DMARC/TLS-RPT reports — deliverability and domain alignment are built in.

pillars.title: Full-protocol access
pillars.summary: IMAP with full CAPABILITY handling, POP3, ManageSieve, and CalDAV/CardDAV/WebDAV — every mailbox protocol served through one access tier.

pillars.title: TLS on every port
pillars.summary: Gate terminates the well-known mail ports (submission 587, SMTPS 465, IMAPS 993) with the platform's post-quantum certificates and discovers healthy instances at runtime.

pillars.title: JMAP, the modern API
pillars.summary: The authenticated JMAP read/write surface powers Webmail and any third-party client — batched, efficient, and protocol-versioned.

units.name: Email8:Mta
units.summary: The mail transfer engine: SMTP/LMTP protocol handling, the durable delivery queue (message + recipient state machine with scheduled retries), DKIM signing, DMARC/TLS-RPT report generation.

units.name: Email8:Store
units.summary: The mail plane's data core: mailboxes, messages, folders, contacts, calendars (the email8 schema) plus the JMAP API — the authenticated read/write surface for the other mail services.

units.name: Email8:Access
units.summary: The mailbox access protocols: IMAP (full CAPABILITY handling), POP3, ManageSieve, and the CalDAV/CardDAV/WebDAV collaboration endpoints — reading mail data through Store.

units.name: Email8:Gate
units.summary: The raw-TCP front door for the well-known mail ports (SMTP submission 587, SMTPS 465, IMAPS 993, …): terminates the TLS/TCP listener set and discovers healthy MTA/Access instances at runtime.

apps.name: Webmail
apps.summary: The browser mail client: mail, calendar, and contacts over the JMAP API through the BFF proxy.

sdks.name: email8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The shared vertical plane: IMAP/SMTP protocol codecs, ical parsing, event contracts, and typed clients every email8 service and integrator consumes.

showcaseLead: Email8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own — identity, events, storage, and scheduling are consumed from the platform.

showcase.name: Sentin8 — the platform
showcase.summary: 17 services: identity, events, storage, workflows, scheduling — everything email8 doesn't rebuild.
